title: Associations of Exposure to Common Plasticizers and Organophosphate Pesticides during Pregnancy and in Childhood with Cognitive Performance in Adolescents: A Population-Based Study.
abstract: Individuals are exposed to chemicals in daily life. Yet, few studies have examined the long-lasting joint effect of prenatal and childhood exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemical (EDC) on cognitive performance.
